best_idea: Other characters' health is one byte, a 0 to 100 ratio that the server computes from its own hp and pushes only on change and only to the people who need the frame, with an explicit hide on leave, so the client never learns the other side's max.
decision_why: Keep ratio-only frames for other characters and exact numbers for self, fix the floor-to-zero bug, the unguarded divide and the 0xFF hide code; park until Frankendom has parties because the duel frame does not need it.
acceptance: In a party of three, member A's frame shows member B as a percent and never B's max hp; a test takes B from 1 hp of 300 to 1 hp and asserts the frame shows 1%, not 0%; leaving the party hides both frames at once.
